releaseNotes:
LifeOS v4.2.0 (4.2.0 · Build 95):
• Top Header Progressive Scrim: Fixed top header status-bar bleeding across CapsuleHeader and Luna Chat with a smooth 8-stop OLED edge fade that dissolves scrolling cards cleanly beneath the floating pill.
• Meal Card Mobile Arrangement: Rearranged MealSlotCard headers into a balanced two-tier layout so full meal names (Breakfast, Lunch, Night Canteen) never truncate, with a dedicated summary & AI Log bar.
• Cleaner Logged Food Cards: Expanded each logged meal row into a spacious two-row layout showing full food titles, kcal & protein (g P) totals, per-serving stats, and portion steppers without cramped ellipsis.
